journal: Journal of Health and Social Behavior
title: A global measure of perceived stress

keyFinding.enGB: The 10-item Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) is a validated self-report measure of the degree to which situations are appraised as stressful.
keyFinding.uk: 10-пунктова Шкала сприйнятого стресу (PSS-10) — валідований самозвітний інструмент оцінки того, наскільки ситуації сприймаються як стресові.

evidenceGrade.rationale: Foundational psychometric validation widely replicated across populations.
